derivation_notes: The parent assumed replenishment_fatigue enters recovery and depletion through the same shared divisor. Here fatigue is allowed to additionally suppress the efficacy of facilitation-driven depletion through a saturating multiplicative modulation, representing stressed mobilization/repriming that limits conversion of release drive into actual vesicle consumption late in sustained trains.
change_summary: The depletion branch now carries an extra factor 1/(1 + baseline_utilization*replenishment_fatigue), while recovery keeps the original fatigue dependence. This changes the scored dx_dt mapping itself by making depletion flatten more strongly than recovery as fatigue accumulates.

assumption_audit.released_assumption: Replenishment fatigue acts as a single shared divisor on both recovery and depletion fluxes with identical dependence.
assumption_audit.mechanism: Under sustained use, fatigued mobilization/repriming reduces how effectively elevated facilitation and presynaptic drive can recruit releasable vesicles into actual consumption, producing an extra nonlinear saturation of depletion with fatigue beyond the recovery slowdown already present.
assumption_audit.parent_reduction: When baseline_utilization*replenishment_fatigue is small so that 1 + baseline_utilization*replenishment_fatigue approaches 1, the successor reduces to the parent depletion law and the full target equation approaches the parent expression.

response_change.parent_relation: The depletion term scales with facilitation and available resource as presynaptic_rate*(1 - release_site_occupancy)*u*x**2 divided by a fatigue factor, so for fixed observed u, x, and release_site_occupancy the target depends on replenishment_fatigue only through a simple reciprocal attenuation shared by both recovery and depletion.
response_change.child_relation: Relax the assumption that replenishment fatigue only rescales both fluxes equally by allowing depletion efficacy itself to saturate more strongly with fatigue than recovery does, creating a nonlinear bending of dx_dt versus replenishment_fatigue at fixed presynaptic_rate, u, x, and release_site_occupancy.
response_change.observable_effect: During sustained high-rate conditions that build appreciable replenishment_fatigue, the child predicts a stronger flattening or rollover of activity-driven depletion than the parent, so late-train dx_dt becomes less negative than expected from the parent's single reciprocal fatigue scaling even when u remains elevated.

evolution_contract.activation_condition: Observable when presynaptic_rate is high enough and stimulation long enough that replenishment_fatigue reaches moderate values while x and u remain nonzero; weak or negligible near replenishment_fatigue ≈ 0.
evolution_contract.train_hidden_contrast: Within training, early versus late portions of the same maintained-rate episode already vary replenishment_fatigue; in holdout, stronger rates or longer trains extend the same contrast by pushing farther into the fatigued regime.
evolution_contract.continuation_path: Recover the parent law in the limit where the extra fatigue dependence of depletion efficacy vanishes, so fatigue again enters dx_dt only through the shared 1/(1 + replenishment_fatigue) factor.
evolution_contract.scientific_mechanism: Under sustained use, fatigued mobilization/repriming reduces how effectively elevated facilitation and presynaptic drive can recruit releasable vesicles into actual consumption, producing an extra nonlinear saturation of depletion with fatigue beyond the recovery slowdown already present.
evolution_contract.difficulty_rationale: This is harder than a coefficient-only correction because the added fatigue-dependent modulation selectively bends the depletion branch while leaving the recovery branch on its original fatigue law, changing the target curvature with respect to replenishment_fatigue rather than merely rescaling the whole RHS.
evolution_contract.assumption_before: Replenishment fatigue acts as a single shared divisor on both recovery and depletion fluxes with identical dependence.
evolution_contract.assumption_after: Replenishment fatigue still slows recovery as before, but it also separately and multiplicatively saturates depletion efficacy so facilitation-driven consumption weakens more strongly at higher fatigue.
evolution_contract.parent_reduction: When baseline_utilization*replenishment_fatigue is negligible, the extra modulation tends to 1 and the parent expression is recovered.
evolution_contract.observable_signature: At fixed observed x, u, release_site_occupancy, and presynaptic_rate, the parent gives dx_dt versus replenishment_fatigue from one shared reciprocal attenuation of both terms, whereas the child introduces extra downward bending only in the depletion branch. Thus early low-fatigue samples remain close to the parent, but late moderate-fatigue samples show dx_dt less negative than the parent predicts because depletion saturates more strongly than recovery.
evolution_contract.shortcut_blocked: A single refit of the parent parameters cannot reproduce this contrast across low- and moderate-fatigue conditions because the parent structurally forces recovery and depletion to move together under the same factor 1/(1 + replenishment_fatigue). Retuning recovery_time_constant, presynaptic_rate, or baseline_utilization only rescales amplitudes or auxiliary trajectories, but cannot create selective fatigue curvature in the scored depletion contribution while preserving the low-fatigue behavior with one shared parameter set.

evolution_plan.activation_condition: Observable when presynaptic_rate is high enough and stimulation long enough that replenishment_fatigue reaches moderate values while x and u remain nonzero; weak or negligible near replenishment_fatigue ≈ 0.
evolution_plan.train_hidden_contrast: Within training, early versus late portions of the same maintained-rate episode already vary replenishment_fatigue; in holdout, stronger rates or longer trains extend the same contrast by pushing farther into the fatigued regime.
evolution_plan.continuation_path: Recover the parent law in the limit where the extra fatigue dependence of depletion efficacy vanishes, so fatigue again enters dx_dt only through the shared 1/(1 + replenishment_fatigue) factor.
evolution_plan.gap_statement: The current model assumes replenishment fatigue attenuates vesicle recovery and vesicle consumption with the same simple multiplicative factor, which is likely too rigid once supply-side stress specifically limits conversion of facilitation drive into actual depletion.
evolution_plan.baseline_assumption: Replenishment fatigue acts as a single shared divisor on both recovery and depletion fluxes with identical dependence.
evolution_plan.scientific_mechanism: Under sustained use, fatigued mobilization/repriming reduces how effectively elevated facilitation and presynaptic drive can recruit releasable vesicles into actual consumption, producing an extra nonlinear saturation of depletion with fatigue beyond the recovery slowdown already present.
evolution_plan.rationale: A realistic next refinement is to change the fatigue coupling in the scored dx_dt itself, not merely an auxiliary equation. In the parent, if x, u, release_site_occupancy, and presynaptic_rate are held fixed, increasing replenishment_fatigue changes dx_dt through one shared reciprocal factor applied symmetrically to recovery and depletion. That imposes a specific curvature: both positive recovery and negative depletion weaken in lockstep as fatigue rises. Scientifically, however, late in a maintained high-rate train the supply side can become so stressed that extra facilitation no longer converts into proportionally more vesicle consumption, even though depleted pools still recover slowly. Thus the child should let depletion efficacy bend downward more strongly with replenishment_fatigue than recovery does. The observable contrast is obtained by varying sustained-use regime through presynaptic_rate and elapsed time while holding the model form and initial conditions fixed: early in the train, when replenishment_fatigue is near zero, parent and child agree closely; later, after fatigue accumulates to moderate levels, the child predicts dx_dt that is less negative than the parent at comparable u and release drive because depletion saturates more strongly. This is admissible under the current observation protocol because replenishment_fatigue is an existing observed state trajectory, so the changed target mapping is directly testable. A single refit of existing parent parameters cannot fully absorb this across both low- and moderate-fatigue conditions because the parent is constrained to one common fatigue divisor shared by recovery and depletion; changing that divisor's coefficient would move both fluxes together rather than selectively altering the curvature of the depletion branch.

scenario_text: Model short-term presynaptic plasticity during a maintained train of action potentials represented by a fixed mean presynaptic rate. One state records the available synaptic-vesicle resource, while another records release facilitation caused by residual presynaptic signaling. Resource recovery, activity-dependent depletion, facilitation buildup, and facilitation decay jointly govern the trajectory. The target is the instantaneous derivative of available vesicle resources.
